notes: Reserved for routing-grade pedestrian road-graph input with preserved topology and access metadata. The display-normalized GIS road layer omits access, foot, oneway, bridge, layer, surface and crossing attributes and is NOT a routing input. Empty array is valid for V0.
input_policy: Use repository-local GIS inputs only (src/data/, datasets/GIS/)
Preserve OSM node identity for intersection detection
Apply mode-specific access policies; missing access is not permissive
Do NOT use the display-normalized GIS road layer as a routing input; it omits access metadata required for routing
